svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits, lines, and tokens
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows aggregate weekly commits and line movement, followed by personal Codex lifetime tokens on the same date domain when history is available. Code movement, last five years at weekly grain. Totals: 3,580 commits, 19,754,605 additions, 19,037,605 deletions, and 137 active weeks. The commit axis uses log1p; the signed additions and deletions axis uses symmetric log. Rounded personal Codex lifetime: 61.3B tokens, observed Jul 29, 2026. 90 personal cumulative daily observations from Apr 30, 2026 through Jul 28, 2026. Dates before tracking began are unobserved, not zero. The token axis is linear from zero and shares the GitHub five-year date domain. Multi-day observation gaps are dashed. The two personal accounts are summed before publication; per-source readings and identities are not published. Provenance: automatic refresh. The approximate conversion is ~$48.7K using this site's current blended public API replay rate of 0.794241 dollars per million tokens as of 2026-07-12; it is not an actual bill.
svg.text: Five years of code movement and personal Codex lifetime-token history
